system_texts: There is uncertainty about whether to include a screen, given ambiguous use and the potential cost, with debate on its necessity versus a wheel-based control.
The iPod-like button system design option has not been concluded yet.
Navigating a large channel lineup with a wheel is challenging and may require fast scrolling or a clear on-device menu.
Access to the on-device menu for brightness, timers and modes is unclear and would rely on a central button that brings up a TV menu.
gold_texts: The group wanted to include a changeable outer casing but could not decide whether the spongy or the hard plastic component should be the removable casing.
There was a lack of information on the cost of several components.
